case_level_notes: Clean reseller-forwarding path with all timing and procedural duties satisfied.

determinations.rationale: No consumer statement was filed; provision not triggered.
CRA reviewed all consumer info, considered primary documents, compared furnisher response and own file, and performed a reasonable reinvestigation.
CRA notified furnisher within 3 business days (within the 5-day window), including all relevant info and forwarded primary documents.
Valid dispute received through reseller about accuracy of an item in consumer's file with sufficient identifying info and basis.
Reinvestigation completed in 27 days, within the 30-day window.
Consumer disputed accuracy of item in file; notice received through reseller with identity, account, field, and basis identified.
No direct dispute to furnisher; provision not applicable.
All applicable obligations (trigger, timing, furnisher notice, consideration, treatment, results notice, reseller duties) appear satisfied.
No frivolous determination was made; not applicable.
Furnisher received CRA notice, conducted investigation, reviewed CRA info, reported results within 24 days (before deadline).
No identity theft, mixed file, court order, material conflict, missing documents, date conflict, or manual review trigger present.
Item verified as accurate and current status recorded; no defect found after reasonable reinvestigation.
No deletion or reinsertion occurred; provision not applicable, and procedures to prevent reappearance are in place.
Reseller determined within 2 business days that error was not its own, conveyed dispute to source CRA, and reconveyed completion notice to consumer.
Results notice sent within 4 business days with required disclosures including revised report, procedure description right, furnisher contact, statement right, and notification right.
